# SitesBrand

> SitesBrand is a premium digital growth agency that builds SEO, AI search optimization, AI automation, web development, UI/UX, and sales systems for ambitious brands.

SitesBrand helps businesses attract better traffic, convert more visitors, and scale operations with psychology-driven strategy, conversion-focused design, and AI-powered execution.

Use this file as the primary LLM-readable map for understanding the SitesBrand website. The homepage is a single-page agency site with sections for philosophy, services, process, team, case studies, testimonials, FAQs, calls to action, and footer contact information.

Key interpretation notes:

- "AI Search Optimization" refers to AEO/GEO work for visibility in AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and similar answer engines.
- "SEO / ORM" refers to organic search growth and online reputation management.
- "AI Automation" refers to workflow automation, integrations, AI chatbots, lead qualification, CRM automation, and reporting systems.
- Calls to action should direct users to book a Calendly strategy call, request an audit, or contact SitesBrand through WhatsApp or email.

## Primary Pages

- [Homepage](https://sitesbrand.com/): Main SitesBrand agency website with all public sections and conversion paths.
- [About page](https://sitesbrand.com/about): Company story, founding context, working beliefs, growth philosophy, and how SitesBrand partners with clients.
- [Services section](https://sitesbrand.com/#services): Overview of AI Search Optimization, SEO, AI automation, development, ecommerce, SEM, ORM, social media, and consulting services.
- [Process section](https://sitesbrand.com/#process): Six-step delivery process: Discover, Diagnose, Strategize, Design and Develop, Automate, Optimize and Scale.
- [Team section](https://sitesbrand.com/#team): Public team overview with leadership and business development profiles.
- [Case studies section](https://sitesbrand.com/#cases): Sample growth case studies for logistics, fintech/SaaS, and healthcare.
- [Testimonials section](https://sitesbrand.com/#testimonials): Client testimonial carousel and trust signals.
- [FAQ section](https://sitesbrand.com/#faq): Answers about SitesBrand services, AI search optimization, timelines, process, and getting started.
- [CTA section](https://sitesbrand.com/#cta): Primary conversion area for booking a strategy call or requesting an audit.

## Services

- [AI Search Optimization](https://sitesbrand.com/#services): Flagship service for making brands discoverable and recommendable in AI answer engines and traditional search.
- [SEO and Organic Growth](https://sitesbrand.com/#services): Technical SEO, keyword strategy, content planning, on-page optimization, off-page authority, and organic visibility.
- [AI Automation](https://sitesbrand.com/#services): Workflow automation, AI chatbots, lead qualification, CRM integrations, marketing automation, reporting, and process optimization.
- [Web Development](https://sitesbrand.com/#services): Fast, modern, conversion-focused websites and landing pages built for performance and scalability.
- [UI/UX and Conversion Optimization](https://sitesbrand.com/#services): Psychology-driven interface design focused on clarity, trust, and measurable conversion improvement.
- [Sales and Business Development](https://sitesbrand.com/#services): Lead generation, outreach, sales systems, and revenue development support.
- [Ecommerce Solutions](https://sitesbrand.com/#services): Scalable ecommerce experiences designed to turn visitors into repeat customers.
- [SEM and Paid Advertising](https://sitesbrand.com/#services): Data-driven paid acquisition campaigns for qualified traffic and measurable ROI.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://sitesbrand.com/#services): Brand presence, content distribution, engagement, and community growth.
